decisions.reason: The version management tool fits the strategy of reducing recurring agency work and builds on the platform, but it was not visible on the website in 2020 to 2021, so it may be underperforming against aspirations; growing industry turnover and the firm's hiring suggest enough slack to carry it for now.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship and core of the firm's direction and is close to its established offer, so it likely meets aspirations and would be improved rather than dropped.
